bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
umask 077
cid=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
rollback=create-videobot:menu-recovery-4decbe6
oldid="$(docker image inspect "$rollback" --format '{{.Id}}')"
stage="$HOME/.local/share/gace-create-videobot/body-edit-93281ac-20261125"
tag=create-videobot:body-edit-93281ac
head=93281acdb54ce49bdd03a9a612223a40a8b61212
test "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true
test "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.Image}}')" = "$oldid"
test "$(docker ps --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=videobot-poll --format '{{.Names}}' | wc -l)" -eq 1
grep -F 'body links preserve exact UTF-16 offsets and published metadata protection' "$stage/new.tap" | grep '^ok '
grep -F 'body text link opens the current owner field; stale old links cannot change it' "$stage/new.tap" | grep '^ok '
test -s "$stage/expected.sha"
diff -u "$stage/expected.sha" "$stage/actual.sha"
for f in src/telegram/creatorUi.mjs src/telegram/creatorWizard.mjs;do
 test "$(git show "$head:$f" | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$(docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint sha256sum "$tag" "/opt/videobot/$f" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
done
project="$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project"}}')"
workdir="$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project.working_dir"}}')"
files="$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project.config_files"}}')"
test "$project" = gace-createvdobot
test -d "$workdir"
IFS=, read -r -a configfiles <<< "$files"
test "${#configfiles[@]}" -gt 0
args=(--project-directory "$workdir" -p "$project")
for file in "${configfiles[@]}";do test -f "$file";args+=(-f "$file");done
export VIDEOBOT_TELEGRAM_TOKEN_SOURCE="$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{range .Mounts}}{{if eq .Destination "/run/secrets/videobot_telegram_token"}}{{.Source}}{{end}}{{end}}')"
export VIDEOBOT_DB_PASSWORD_SOURCE="$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{range .Mounts}}{{if eq .Destination "/run/secrets/videobot_db_password"}}{{.Source}}{{end}}{{end}}')"
export VIDEOBOT_STICKER_PIN_STATE_SOURCE="$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{range .Mounts}}{{if eq .Destination "/var/lib/videobot/sticker-entry"}}{{.Source}}{{end}}{{end}}')"
export VIDEOBOT_VIDEO_WORK_SOURCE="$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{range .Mounts}}{{if eq .Destination "/var/lib/videobot/media-work"}}{{.Source}}{{end}}{{end}}')"
export GSERVER_POSTGRES_USER="$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{range .Config.Env}}{{println .}}{{end}}' | sed -n 's/^VIDEOBOT_DB_USER=//p' | head -n1)"
export VIDEOBOT_SHOP_PUBLIC_URL="$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{range .Config.Env}}{{println .}}{{end}}' | sed -n 's/^VIDEOBOT_SHOP_PUBLIC_URL=//p' | head -n1)"
export CREATEVDOBOT_TERMS_URL="$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{range .Config.Env}}{{println .}}{{end}}' | sed -n 's/^CREATEVDOBOT_TERMS_URL=//p' | head -n1)"
export GSERVER_POSTGRES_NETWORK="$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{range $name, $net := .NetworkSettings.Networks}}{{println $name}}{{end}}' | head -n1)"
test -n "$VIDEOBOT_TELEGRAM_TOKEN_SOURCE" && test -n "$VIDEOBOT_DB_PASSWORD_SOURCE" && test -n "$VIDEOBOT_STICKER_PIN_STATE_SOURCE" && test -n "$GSERVER_POSTGRES_USER" && test -n "$GSERVER_POSTGRES_NETWORK"
test -d "$VIDEOBOT_VIDEO_WORK_SOURCE" && mountpoint -q /mnt/g
newOverride="$stage/compose.body-edit.yaml"
oldOverride="$stage/compose.rollback.yaml"
printf 'services:\n  videobot-poll:\n    image: %s\n    pull_policy: never\n' "$tag" > "$newOverride"
printf 'services:\n  videobot-poll:\n    image: %s\n    pull_policy: never\n' "$rollback" > "$oldOverride"
# Validate the resolved service against the running service, without disclosing values.
docker compose "${args[@]}" -f "$newOverride" config --format json > "$stage/config-candidate.json"
docker compose "${args[@]}" -f "$oldOverride" config --quiet
python3 - "$cid" "$stage/config-candidate.json" <<'PY'
import json,subprocess,sys,os
live=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['docker','inspect',sys.argv[1]]))[0]
svc=json.load(open(sys.argv[2]))['services']['videobot-poll']
env=dict(x.split('=',1) for x in live['Config']['Env'] if '=' in x)
new=svc.get('environment',{})
bad=[k for k,v in new.items() if str(v if v is not None else '')!=env.get(k,'')]
bad += [k for k in env if k.startswith(('VIDEOBOT_','VIDEO_SALE_','GSERVER_')) and k not in new]
if bad: print('UNEXPECTED_ENV_KEY_DIFF',sorted(set(bad)));sys.exit(72)
oldmount={m['Destination']:(os.path.realpath(m['Source']),m['RW']) for m in live['Mounts'] if m['Type']=='bind'}
newmount={m['target']:(os.path.realpath(m['source']),not m.get('read_only',False)) for m in svc.get('volumes',[]) if m.get('type')=='bind'}
if oldmount!=newmount: print('UNEXPECTED_BIND_MOUNT_DIFF');sys.exit(73)
print('EXISTING_ENV_AND_BIND_MOUNTS_PRESERVED')
PY
rm -f "$stage/config-candidate.json"
test "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.Image}}')" = "$oldid"
armed=YES
restore(){ docker compose "${args[@]}" -f "$oldOverride" up -d --no-build --force-recreate videobot-poll >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }
trap 'if test "$armed" = YES;then restore;fi' EXIT
docker compose "${args[@]}" -f "$newOverride" up -d --no-build --force-recreate videobot-poll >/dev/null
ready=NO
for n in $(seq 1 20);do
 if test "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.State.Running}}' 2>/dev/null)" = true && docker logs "$cid" 2>&1 | grep -Fq 'CREATOR_DM_POLL_READY=PASS' && docker logs "$cid" 2>&1 | grep -Fq 'STICKER_SHOP_HTTP_READY=PASS';then ready=YES;break;fi
 sleep 2
done
test "$ready" = YES || { echo BODY_LINK_NOT_READY;exit 57; }
test "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.Image}}')" = "$(docker image inspect "$tag" --format '{{.Id}}')"
test "$(docker ps --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=videobot-poll --format '{{.Names}}' | wc -l)" -eq 1
docker exec -i -w /opt/videobot "$cid" sh -c 'while IFS= read -r f;do sha256sum "$f" || exit 1;done' < "$stage/runtime-files.txt" > "$stage/deployed.sha"
diff -u "$stage/expected.sha" "$stage/deployed.sha"
sleep 8
test "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true
test "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.RestartCount}}')" = 0
armed=NO
trap - EXIT
echo BODY_LINK_DEPLOYED_AND_RUNTIME_SOURCE_VERIFIED
docker exec "$cid" node -e 'console.log("TERMS_CONFIGURED="+Boolean(process.env.CREATEVDOBOT_TERMS_URL));console.log("INVOICE_MODE_PRESERVED="+(process.env.VIDEO_SALE_MODE==="invoice"))'
